description: Create a new audience segment (named group of people) for the authenticated user. Set type='manual' for a hand-curated list (use add_to_segment to populate it), type='smart' with a `config` predicate (e.g. {title_contains:'VP'}) to define a dynamic segment resolved on-demand by resolve_segment, or pass `template` to pre-fill `config` from a built-in template (type defaults to 'smart'). Free — costs 0 credits.

config.description: Predicate object for smart segments. Supported keys: title_contains, company_contains, company_industry, engaged_with_topics. Required when type='smart' and no template is supplied.

name.description: User-facing segment name. Optional when `template` is supplied — the template's default name is used.

source_stream_id.description: Optional stream that produced this segment (for traceability)

template.description: Optional pre-built template id. Available: 'vp_plus' (VP+ decision-makers), 'c_suite' (C-suite executives), 'heads_of' ('Head of' leaders), 'founders' (Founders & co-founders), 'fintech_leaders' (Fintech leaders), 'agency_owners' (Agency owners). Pre-fills `config` and defaults `type` to 'smart'. Explicit `config` overrides template values on collision.

type.description: Segment type. 'manual' = hand-curated person list. 'smart' = dynamic predicate (requires `config`). 'auto_stream' = system-managed from a stream. Defaults to 'smart' when `template` is provided.

name: create_segment
title: Create Audience Segment
